# defer Agent Context

> Map for agents. Start from the product contract and support matrix before
> implementation files.

## Product contract

- [README](README.md): capabilities, primary workflow, and contract discovery.
- [STATUS](STATUS.md): support matrix; each row names its executable gate.
- [ROADMAP](ROADMAP.md): future outcomes and explicit non-goals.
- [ADRs](docs/adr): design decisions carried by the source.
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to change defer and which gates to run.

## Source

- `crates/defer-shared-kernel`: scheduler, task, queue, lease, and settlement types.
- `crates/defer-replication`: Raft state machine, host, bootstrap seed, peer TLS.
- `crates/defer-dispatch`: HTTP target dispatch, retries, and signing.
- `crates/defer-access`: per-queue authorization.
- `crates/defer-queue`: HTTP API router and OpenAPI.
- `crates/defer-operator`: Kubernetes operator (feature `operator`).
- `crates/defer`: the `defer` binary and the integration tests in `crates/defer/tests`.

## Commands

- Format: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- Lint: `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- Test: `cargo test --locked --workspace`
- Operator: `cargo test -p defer --features operator --test operator`
- Product docs: `python3 -B scripts/meta/project_docs_contract.py check .`
